Prompt Pop 2K26

A competition experience with something to play for.

Visit live website

About the project

An interactive platform for an AI prompting and design competition, organising participant entry and creative challenges into one distinct experience.

Institution
Crescent Institute · Department of Computer Science and Engineering
Year
2026
Role
Built independently by a Webly co-founder
Technology
React · Vite · Tailwind CSS · Vercel
Typical build window
2–3 weeks
Scope
Competition platform · Participant interface · Interactive round design
Website
Open live project

Give each round a clear entry point

Bring several kinds of competition rounds into a single participant journey. Teams need a clear entry point, understandable instructions, and a way to move through each challenge.

One platform for timed and creative challenges

Team-code entry introduces a sequence of timed and creative rounds, including a quiz, image recreation, a comedy bonus, and logo design, with a route to results.

Inside the website

  • Team-code entry

  • Timed quiz round

  • Image recreation and creative design challenges

  • Results access

From team code to results

Teams enter with a code and use one platform for the quiz, creative challenges, and results.

Visual direction

A bold typographic direction and high-contrast interface make the platform feel like an event while keeping the participant actions clear.
